root_cause: PR #2096 deliberately delivered a host-independent durable Orchestrator but left Host-specific wrappers as future work. There is therefore no single repository-owned validation and dispatch boundary between ChatGPT/Codex command messages and the Orchestrator methods, and no canonical root CLI transport.
causal_chain: StarterHostOrchestrator exposes correct Python methods with exact revision and phase checks.
The root skillctl command does not expose those methods.
No closed command schema binds operation, Host, session, revision, and operation-specific payload.
A Host integration must consequently duplicate method mapping, error handling, and response projection.
Duplicated wrappers can omit correlation fields, accept unexpected inputs, or reinterpret authority even though the Orchestrator itself is safe.
rejected_hypotheses: Put natural-language routing in the CLI; semantic interpretation belongs to ChatGPT/Codex and exact selection validation already exists.
Let the CLI directly run Skills, Providers, or LangGraph; the existing Orchestrator and Runtime are their only control path.
Encode write permission in a command flag; only the existing injected WriteAuthorityGuard may authorize mutation.
Load an implementation factory named inside an untrusted command request; bootstrap code must be selected explicitly by the operator outside the request envelope.
Keep a long-lived model call open during external waits; sessions and checkpoints already provide durable resume.
